info.desc: The fifth studio album by the experimental hip-hop trio Death Grips, released on May 6, 2016 on Third Worlds and Harvest Records. Features guest vocals from Clementine Creevy and guitar from Nick Reinhart of the math rock band Tera Melos. .

podcast.body: This album was followed by a period of incomprehensible pause for the band, leading to much speculation about new projects and the band's future direction. During this phase, MC Raik's lyrical style evolved to include more structured and worked verses, with choruses that were more identifiable and contained fewer invented words, which some fans found made the arguments easier to follow. However, this period also saw the band's sound lose some of its "spontaneous aggressiveness," becoming more studio-polished, which did not convince all listeners. "cuando la banda había tenido como esa pausa que nadie terminó entender con el botonlesspeak"
